log.wasmFailed: The stream engine failed to start. Reload the page.
auth.help: Sign in to load your consoles and settings on any device.
auth.helpRegister: Create an account to save your consoles and settings.
account.title: Account settings
account.needCurrent: Enter your current password to save changes.
account.deleteHelp: This permanently deletes your account, consoles and settings.
share.title: Share stream
share.help: While you stream, people with the link receive video, audio and, if you allow it, the virtual pad or a physical gamepad. You can block buttons for both. The viewer virtual pad uses your theme.
share.vpadKeysHelp: Unchecked buttons are blocked for viewers, on the virtual pad and on a physical gamepad.
share.guest: You are watching a shared stream.
share.missing: This share link is no longer active.
share.needStream: Video/audio sharing starts when you launch a stream.
share.keywordsHelp: Several words: separate them with a comma, a semicolon or a new line (e.g. Help, password). If a word appears on screen, sharing pauses.
share.keywordDelayWarn: Your own game stays live. Viewers are a few seconds behind: a frame is sent only after the screen was checked with no keyword, so pause happens before they see the word.
share.keywordIdle: Enable sharing and start a stream to watch for keywords.
vpad.hint: The on-screen virtual pad is toggled from the stream toolbar. Place its buttons and adjust transparency in the full-screen editor.
vpad.themeHelp: Choose a supplied skin. In the layout editor you can also assign your own image to each button.
vpad.customIdle: Select a button to assign a custom image.
vpad.editorHelp: Drag a button to move it. Use the corner handle or the mouse wheel to resize. The editor matches the stream at 1:1.
help.title: Documentation
defaultsHint: * Defaults in () to right of value or marked with (Default)
consoles.hint: Registered and discovered consoles. Each can have its own PSN Account ID (base64). Hidden consoles stay hidden until you show them again.
consoles.empty: No consoles yet. Connect Chiaki Home Proxy or add a console.
keys.mouseHint: Click the video to lock the cursor in keyboard/mouse mode. The virtual pad keeps the cursor free. F8 toggles lock by default.
keys.hint: Click a cell, then press a keyboard key or a mouse button.
controllers.hint: The first PlayStation / standard Gamepad API controller is used (DualShock / DualSense). After plugging it in, press any button — no page reload needed.
config.hint: LAN Remote Play only. PSN / holepunch is not available in the WASM build.
config.hintHome: Chiaki Home Proxy relays traffic to your console. No router ports to open.
config.proxyHelp: By default, this page’s local proxy is used (its address is not shown). Custom lets you set another WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://).
config.proxyBad: Invalid URL. Use ws:// or wss://.
config.proxyIpNotUrl: That looks like the console’s IP, not a proxy URL. Keep Proxy on Default, then add the console (+) with this address.
config.homeProxyOn: Connected via Chiaki Home Proxy. Traffic goes through your PC, with no router ports to open.
config.proxyApproveText: A Chiaki Home Proxy ({name}) wants to relay traffic to your consoles. No router ports are opened.
config.proxyDlHelp: Download it, run it on the PC next to your console, then sign in with this account. No router ports to open.
config.proxyDlMissing: No build published for this platform yet.
config.psnHelp: Default PSN Account ID (8-byte base64) for new PS5 registrations. Each console can also have its own ID in the Consoles tab.
add.title: Add Manual Host
add.homeHint: Connected via Chiaki Home Proxy. Enter the console’s LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.70).
add.homeHintPending: Approve Chiaki Home Proxy first, then test the console’s LAN IP.
add.portcheckNeedHome: This LAN address is only reachable via Chiaki Home Proxy. Run it on the PC next to the console, sign in with this account, then click Approve.
add.portcheckNeedApprove: Approve the Chiaki Home Proxy connection first, then test again.
add.portcheckOkHome: TCP 9295 is reachable via Chiaki Home Proxy (no NAT forwarding needed).
add.portcheckWarn: TCP 9295 is not open. Forward it (NAT / firewall) then test again.
add.portcheckWarnHome: The console is not reachable from the Chiaki Home Proxy PC (LAN).
add.portcheckNeedTest: TCP 9295 must pass before adding the console.
add.name: Name
regist.title: Register Console
regist.help: On the console: Settings → Remote Play → Add Device. Enter the PIN shown there.
regist.psnHelp: PS5 requires your PSN Account ID, not your online ID. Look up opens psntools in the browser, or paste the base64 / numeric ID.
confirm.hideText:
Are you sure you want to hide this console?

Note: You can unhide from the Consoles section of the Settings under Hidden Consoles
confirm.deleteText: Are you sure you want to delete this console?
disconnect.title: Disconnect Session
disconnect.text: Do you want the Console to go into sleep mode?
keycap.title: Key Capture
keycap.help: Press a key for the keyboard. Click inside the Mouse box for a mouse button or the wheel. × to remove.
keycap.helpKb: Press a keyboard key. Delete to clear.
keycap.helpMs: Click a mouse button or use the wheel. Delete to clear.
pin.title: Login PIN
pin.help: Enter the PIN displayed on the console.
host.foreign: This console is already linked to another account.
log.hevcFallback: HEVC is not supported in this browser, falling back to H264.
log.webcodecsMissing: WebCodecs is unavailable in this browser.
log.psnHint: PS5 registration needs a valid PSN Account ID (look up your username or paste the base64 ID).
log.psnUserRequired: Enter a PSN username to look up.
log.connectFailed: Unable to connect to the console.
log.wakeTimeout: Console did not wake in time, trying to connect anyway.
quit.2: Session request failed (console may be in rest mode)
quit.4: Remote Play is already in use on the console
quit.5: Remote Play crashed on the console
log.registIpv6: IPv6 is not supported. Use the box public IPv4 (e.g. 82.x.x.x), not a 2a01:… address.
log.registLanHint: PIN pairing must be done on the LAN (192.168.x.x). Then add the console with the public IPv4 and the Regist / Morning keys.
log.bitrateCapped: Bitrate limited to {kbps} kbps for a stable Web stream.
log.proxyDown: Local proxy unreachable. Run: node wasm/proxy/server.mjs
log.insecureOrigin: This origin is not a secure context: WASM threads need HTTPS or localhost. Open {url} and accept the certificate.
